subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should credential reveal state be ephemeral and masked by default per field, or may OpenClaw persist visibility preferences across sessions and platforms?
rationale: The UX request is valid, but persisting clear-text visibility changes credential exposure behavior and needs maintainer security/product intent before implementation.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Add per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

options.title: Persist Local Preference
options.body: Allow local persistence only after maintainers explicitly accept the shared-device and recording exposure tradeoff and define reset behavior.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep the existing partial web behavior until maintainers approve a full credential-field inventory and platform owner plan.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Add per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this issue and has the strongest current routing signal across the affected web and macOS/iOS surfaces.
